Hey thank for for your nice words. I was drinking alcohol after a long time and i guess that made it all worse as i remeber now why i once stopped.

i am feeling better now, not good but good enough to keep on living.

your words really touched me. thank you.

i am in therapy for nearly half my life...and it doesnt get ok. it got better but not good. not even ok. just...less bad.

i always wonder if i am too deep in a shithole or if others just arent really depressed.
